# PositionScope · 仓位镜

> Independent, read-only macOS menu-bar position monitor. Current release v0.2.0-beta.2 is signed and notarized for Apple Silicon and Intel; native UI and real-account tests are still pending. Planned features are not released features.

## Product
- [Overview](https://positionscope.funagent.app/): Features and synthetic demonstration
- [English overview](https://positionscope.funagent.app/en/): Current capabilities and limits
- [Downloads](https://positionscope.funagent.app/download/): Verified release status
- [Risk methodology](https://positionscope.funagent.app/guides/portfolio-risk/): Formulas and limitations
- [Read-only setup](https://positionscope.funagent.app/guides/read-only-api/): Permissions and local credentials
- [Privacy](https://positionscope.funagent.app/privacy/): Current data handling
- [Roadmap](https://positionscope.funagent.app/roadmap/): Released versus planned capabilities
- [Source](https://github.com/hash-panda/positionscope): MIT-declared source repository

No exchange affiliation. No profit forecasts or verified performance claims. Local credentials are not yet encrypted through Keychain. AI processing is opt-in and sends sensitive risk aggregates to the selected model provider.
